sym:moflo_cloud_app_personas_components_.whatItDoes: Checks whether a setting should apply to one specific app. Takes a list of app names and one app; if the list is empty or missing it applies to all apps, otherwise it matches the app name against the list ignoring letter case.
dataIn: list of app names or null/empty
manipulation: checks if app name is in the list
dataOut: true or false, whether the setting applies to that app
sym:moflo_cloud_app_personas_components_.observed: A person would see certain toggle rows only show up for the apps they're meant for, and show up everywhere if no apps were specified.
